The RedHawks, led by fourth-year head coach [[John Cooper (basketball)|John Cooper]], played their home games at [[Millett Hall]], as members of the East Division of the [[Mid-American Conference]]. They finished the season 13–20, 6–12 in MAC play to finish in fifth place in the East Division. They defeated [[2015–16 Ball State Cardinals men's basketball team|Ball State]] in the first round of the [[2016 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] to advance to the quarterfinals, where they lost to [[2015–16 Buffalo Bulls men's basketball team|Buffalo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/miami-oh/men/2016-schedule.html |title=2015–16 Miami (OH) RedHawks Men's Schedule and Results |work=[[Basketball Reference]] |accessdate=August 4, 2026}} ==Previous season== The [[2014–15 Miami RedHawks men's basketball team|RedHawks]] finished the season 13–19, 8–10 in MAC play to finish in fifth place in the East Division.
